lyrics:
碼頭的風把話吹散
我看著繩子，怕船再也回不來
後來父親陪我坐到天色泛白
海面一點一點亮起來
我終於放開手，願意等新的一天
expected: Harbor before dawn, anxiety yielding to reassurance and sunrise

lyrics:
The garden gate creaked after everyone had gone
I carried anger like a stone in my coat
Beside the pond I listened to the birds
The stone slipped from my hand into the water
I watched the ripples fade and walked home calm
expected: Garden and pond, anger yielding to calm in still water

lyrics:
雨のバス停で誰も来ないと思った
傘の下で小さくなっていた
遠くから妹が手を振った
ふたりで水たまりをよけながら笑った
濡れた道にも帰る場所ができた
expected: Rainy bus stop and wet road, loneliness turning to reunion and warmth

lyrics:
해변의 빈 의자에서 너를 기다렸어
저녁 햇빛이 아직 따뜻했어
네가 오지 않는다는 전화를 받았어
파도가 발자국을 모두 지웠어
어두워진 바다 앞에서 혼자 울었어
expected: Beach at sunset turning dark, waiting and warmth turning into grief
